0.EN: "What are we doing at Miracle Maid Cafe?"

1.EN:
Remember what Maegawa-san said?
The ghost used to look at waitresses!

2.EN: I think she'll love to get something related to maids!

5.EN: I'm happy to see you two again!

7.EN:
I'll order the best dish in this cafe!
In exchange, I would like to ask you for a favor!

8.EN:
You enjoy a meal with Shiro,
who spends the whole time raving about maids...

9.EN: ...Fufu, is that it? Sure, I can do that much.

16.EN:
Ohhhhhhh...! A polaroid with Suzuka-san and the
other Miracle maids...! This will be my family heirloom!

17.EN:
Hey, don't mention it! That was so much fun!
Here you go, Mr. Manager. You get one too.

19.EN: Let's share this moment of bliss with the ghost!

20.EN:
Welcome home, Master... wait, oh!
You're Fuwa Fuwa's manager.

21.EN: "I'm here to return the manga Shiro borrowed from you."

22.EN: ...Huh? But I haven't lent her any manga.

24.EN: Maybe there was some sort of misunderstanding...?

25.EN: "I don't know. I swear Shiro told me to return this to you..."

26.EN: ...Hey, has Shiro been acting strangely today?

27.EN: Has she been weirdly fidgety, like she's trying to hide something...?

28.EN:
"Now that you mention it... And it's not just Shiro,
everyone's been acting kind of weird."

29.EN: Uh-huhhh... I get it. She's like an open book, as usual. Hehe.

30.EN:
As for the manga, I'll take them off your hands.
I'll message Shiro later.

31.EN: You thank Suzuka and leave the cafe.

32.EN: (All right, I'll go pick up the thing I ordered from the restaurant.)

33.EN:
Suzuka-san!
Will Miracle Maid Cafe be doing anything for the summer festival?

34.EN:
Mari-chan suggested we do a food stand,
so that's what we're going with!

35.EN:
The plan is to direct the food stand customers
over here so they visit the cafe too!

36.EN:
I see! It's a strategy you can only use
when you have so many members of staff!

37.EN:
We're thinking of giving out free souvenirs to the food stall customers.
Which would be better...?

39.EN: That's great! I would want to collect them too!

40.EN: I'm stealing that idea! Not bad!

41.EN: Oh! You're the manager of Fuwa Fuwa!

42.EN:
Hm? Free trial tickets? Oh, I'm so sorry!
We've run out of those thanks to everyone's support!

43.EN:
We always have other campaigns and events going on, though,
so please come back any time!
